caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a bonnet, which appears to be made out of a soft, light-colored fabric such as muslin or lace. The bonnet is rendered in shades of beige, cream, and light brown, with careful detailing to show the fine mesh and texture of the fabric. The bonnet has a gathered, ruched crown, and a wide frill of ruffled lace that frames the face opening, extending around the entire front edge. Two long, wide ribbons or ties hang down on either side, rendered in the same light fabric as the rest of the bonnet, with gentle shading indicating folds and creases. The background is plain and uncolored, with no other objects present. The artist’s signature, “Lilian Causey,” is written in small letters near the bottom right corner of the page.
title: Night Cap
